title: fix: keep Ling free with direct Novita and two fallbacks
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps `inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash` free on all three routes: direct Novita → OpenRouter pinned to Novita → Vercel pinned to Novita. Same upstream ID throughout; aliases: none; multiplier: 1×; paid-only: no; Pollinations GPU: no; registry provider: `novita`.
- Fixes native thinking controls and enforces reasoning visibility for JSON/SSE without changing provider-reported usage. Registers Novita for cost attribution; gateway routes remain hidden.
- Validation: 277 focused Gen tests, 63 Enter pricing tests, 541 shared/provider checks, both typechecks and Biome pass. Live direct and forced Vercel checks verified tools, reasoning, streaming, permissions and cache reuse. Real staging Tinybird rows reconcile usage/attribution with zero cost, zero price and no wallet debit.
- Live limitations: OpenRouter probes remain capacity-limited; some full-chain and Messages/native fallback probes exhaust capacity. All routes depend on Novita; alternate gateways do not add GPU capacity. Runtime credential rollout needs separate approval; no deployment performed.
- Pricing stays in #16256. Current free pricing: [Novita](https://novita.ai/models/model-detail/inclusionai-ling-3.1-flash), [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash), [Vercel](https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/ling-3.1-flash-free).

Addresses #16597.

gist.headline: Ling takes the garden path
gist.blurb: Ling 3.1 Flash keeps its free route through Novita, with two alternate gateways pointing to the same model. Its thinking controls and reasoning output get a tidy-up too.
gist.summary: Ling 3.1 Flash stays free at 1× with direct Novita as its primary route and OpenRouter and Vercel fallbacks pinned to the same Novita upstream; the fix also handles native thinking controls and preserves reasoning visibility in JSON and SSE.
gist.impact: Users get consistent free Ling routing and visible reasoning across JSON and streaming responses, while provider-reported usage stays unchanged; the fallback gateways do not add GPU capacity.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Ling as a glowing model terminal in a cozy garden, reached by three paths labeled Novita, OpenRouter, and Vercel that converge on one Novita flower pot. Polli tends the paths with a tiny gardener's hat; a small reasoning scroll beside the terminal represents visible thinking without suggesting three separate sources of capacity.
